title: One Refund Across a Service Boundary -- Cross-Repository Orchestration
objectives: Audit each repository independently and reconcile evidence at the service boundary.
Produce a build-ready specification from verified evidence without inventing unsupported behavior.
Define compatibility, ownership, dependencies, and bounded agent contracts for both repositories.
Execute the bounded repository changes and verify each repository against its acceptance criteria.
Prove the pair works together, independently review each repository, and disposition every material finding.
Record what was proven, what remains open, and the reusable practice to carry forward.
start_step: Ground the Work (not a numbered stage)
